name: Tic-tac-toe
description: Launch a tic-tac-toe board from the apps menu (or type /tic-tac-toe) and play it in the channel, or add one to a voice canvas from its menu. The first person to move is X, the next different person is O, and moves out of turn are refused. Everyone else watches. Each message or canvas tile is its own game, and 'new game' restarts it. The board and the two players' opaque module ids are kept by the module in its own database (data.store, which an admin approves at install) and dropped a day after the last move; it learns nothing else about you.

changes: The board and the two seats are kept by the module, so a made-up state can no longer take both seats or rewrite the board. Needs the data.store approval in the Dock.
A game already in progress when this version is installed starts over on its next tap.
Can be added to a voice canvas as a tile everyone in the call plays. Needs a server with add-on API 6.
Drops a second copy of each response the module kept and never read.
Rebuilt with the reproducible build recipe; works the same.
Players are seated by who joins first, and a move out of turn is refused.
